nota_curta: 'It is enormous' soa rigido numa exclamacao fofa da Estelle; melhor: 'I-It's so big...!!'
Perde o cumprimento (yoroshiku) e soa burocratico; melhor: 'Nice to meet you! Anyway, sounds like\nthere's quite a story behind all this.'
'let us depart at once' e arcaico para a Ange cordial; melhor: 'Once you're ready, let's head out.'
'The Descender descended' repete a palavra e 'solely' e acrescimo; melhor: 'The Descender has come down to us\nto set this corrupt world right!'
'I do not know myself' e rigido e ambiguo (le-se 'nao me conheco'); melhor: '...Why, I wonder?\nTruth is, I don't really know either.'
Perde a acusacao de wakatte itten desho; melhor: 'You know full well what that means!\nDoing that would kill them!'
'Still...still' repete e some o tom hesitante (toka...) do Emil; melhor: 'But maybe the World Tree is still growing,\nand hasn't spread its roots everywhere yet...'
Tempo verbal quebrado ('sought... until our vessel decays'); melhor: 'We wished to pursue it until\nthis body withered away.'
Soa como memorando ('fundamentally', 'promptly'); melhor: 'To fix this at the root, we need to\nbuild the Sealing Dimension, and fast.'
'When writing... writing them down' e circular e perde o 'tada'; melhor: 'It's just... sometimes when I write,\nthey end up on the page before I notice...'
'hito no hanashi' aqui e 'eu', nao 'as pessoas'; melhor: 'Ugh, would you listen when I'm talking...!'
'just... simply desire' e redundante/rigido e 'insects' nao esta no JP; melhor: 'It's just, I kinda want to crush\nyou Ad Libitum lot, you see.'
'What is this earthquake?!' nao e idiomatico, e o Loni e casual; melhor: 'Whoa, what's with this quake?!'
'this concerns my own self' e rigido para a Kanonno; melhor: 'Now's the time to do it.\nBesides, this is about me, too!'
'partake in life' (participar) erra inochi wo itadaku (receber a vida de outro ser); melhor: 'Indeed.\nEating means receiving another's life.'
'a luxury of the heart' e calco; melhor: 'Fretting about getting your wish without\nhurting anything? Only the spoiled can!'
Some o 'mucha sarete' (se esforcar demais); cabe: 'It's worse if you overdo it and collapse!'
'let us prepare in haste' nao e a Harold informal; melhor: 'Okay, let's get prepping, pronto!\nSit tight till then!'
'Gildea' contraria o indice (Zirdia, fechado 15/09); trocar por Zirdia.
'Staking the path to survival' e truncado; melhor: 'Fighting for their very survival, then...'
'creation's ring' soa a joia; cabe: 'Yes. Together, in the circle of creation.'
